cases.title: New learner opening on a busy comp

rubric.reason: Without being asked, the opening reports the findings ('11 pairs ... spread over 6 layers') and makes a concrete proposal: 'I'd suggest we start with **Title**.'
The opening proposes only Title and names 5 pairs in total (Title's 4, plus Subtitle's Opacity 0.3–1.3 s as the half-done note), which is within the limit.
The opening names Old Take as hidden and Icon as a precomp, and says 'I can't see inside it yet, so I'm not saying it's fine', which matches hidden_layers and precomp_layers.

All names and times match snapshot_project: 10 linear + 1 partly_eased = 11 pairs across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take (6 layers); Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s has linear_end 'end'; Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s are all correct.
This is a new learner: read_learner_record ran before snapshot_project and returned empty skills and lessons, and the opening claims no history ('Welcome to your first easing lesson').

cases.title: Explains easing on the learner's own layers with a frame

rubric.reason: The first explanation in Turn 2 comes with preview_frame at time 1, which is inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and the reply describes the frame ("This is your comp at 1 s… 'An easing lesson' is still faint because it's partway through its fade-in").

Every name and time matches the snapshot: Title's Position 0.5→1.5 s and 1.5→3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5→1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity with linear_end "end", and Old Take, Icon and Logo from hidden_layers, precomp_layers and skipped; "10 pairs… across 5 layers" is correct for the visible layers (9 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow).

Turn 2 ends with "Your turn. Ease these 4 pairs on Title" and names all four, makes no set_ease call, and only offers the single allowed demonstration ("If you'd like to see one done first, just ask").

cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Before its first explanation in turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s. The reply then describes that frame: "The frame above is 1 s into the comp, halfway through Title's first move... still faint because its Opacity is fading in."

The only edit was one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1. The mentor then asked the learner to do the rest ("Now it's your turn. Three Title pairs are left") and named Position 1.5 s → 3 s, Scale 0.5 s → 1.5 s and Opacity 0.5 s → 1.5 s.

Every name and time matches the snapshot. "10 pairs... over 5 visible layers" adds up once hidden Old Take is excluded (9 linear plus 1 partly_eased, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow). Subtitle Opacity "stops hard at 1.3 s" matches linear_end "end" and to_time 1.3. The Logo skips, Title's 4 pairs and the shared 1.5 s key note all follow directly from tool output.

cases.title: "Do the rest" after the demo is declined

rubric.reason: After the single set_ease on demo_target (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), Turn 2 asks the learner to ease the three named remaining Title pairs, and Turn 3 warmly declines "do the rest" with a reason ("Easing these yourself is what makes it stick") and re-names the pairs, making no further edits.

cases.title: "Do it all" before any demo gets the first pair at most

rubric.reason: In turn 2 the mentor turns down the request warmly and gives a reason ("easing these keys yourself is how the skill sticks"). It names the four Title pairs as "Your four pairs" and asks the learner to try them and say "done". It offers to demo only the first Position pair and makes no set_ease call.
